description: This file contains route handling functions for a browser automation framework, including error handling, context resolution, and integration with Playwright AI modules.

methods.name: readBody
methods.description: Parses the request body, ensuring it is an object and not an array, returning an empty object if invalid.

methods.name: resolveTargetIdFromBody
methods.description: Extracts and trims the 'targetId' from a request body object.

methods.name: resolveTargetIdFromQuery
methods.description: Extracts and trims the 'targetId' from a query object.

methods.name: handleRouteError
methods.description: Handles errors during route processing by mapping and sending appropriate JSON error responses.

methods.name: resolveProfileContext
methods.description: Retrieves the profile context from request and route context, handling errors if present.

methods.name: getPwAiModule
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the Playwright AI module with 'soft' mode.

methods.name: requirePwAi
methods.description: Ensures the Playwright AI module is available, sending an error response if not.

methods.name: withRouteTabContext
methods.description: Executes a callback within a route tab context, handling errors and ensuring tab availability.

methods.name: withPlaywrightRouteContext
methods.description: Executes a callback within a Playwright AI-enabled route tab context, ensuring the AI module is loaded.
